cost.note: Includes the 80 smoke requests once via cache reuse. E7/framework extra requests reported separately; download/install excluded.

whole_device_memory.scope: Whole GPU including desktop/other processes; 2-second sampling within active monitor windows, with gaps across interruptions. May miss brief transients. Per-request allocator peaks are separate.

base_06b.local_revision_note: Harness model_revision main is a local-loader default, not provenance. Full identity hashes are in runs/model/config.json; 4B upstream revision is in its verified download_manifest.json.

instruct_4b.local_revision_note: Harness model_revision main is a local-loader default, not provenance. Full identity hashes are in runs/model/config.json; 4B upstream revision is in its verified download_manifest.json.

output_integrity.note: Validates records, without replacing failures or modifying raw outputs.

limitations: Model differences include scale, model version and instruction training
Human sufficiency subset only dev26; single reviewer identity/time unknown
AI assisted 16 opinions on 2 questions; different reviewers per model; illustrative only, not human truth
Reason output is not direct evidence of internal reasoning
McNemar comparisons exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment; no macro-F1 significance claim
